description: Store whose published home page shows a Category List widget (PortalMapping) with at least N active categories, in display order, plus the first of them after the first listing at least M products on its PLP (counted as CATEGORY_WITH_PRODUCTS).

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); the resolved store must be this store

minCategories.description: Fewest active categories the home page category widget must show. Left out: any

minProducts.description: Fewest products the opened category (openCategory*: first featured category after the first) must list, e.g. above the PLP page size. Left out: any count
